info.name: Task Manager API - Extended Validation (Codetrain Africa)
info.description: Codetrain Africa Backend Development Assignment: Extended validation on Task Manager API using express-validator and dedicated validators module.

request.description: Returns a list of all tasks. (Status: 200 OK)

item.name: 2. GET Tasks Filter - Valid completed=true (200 OK)

query.description: Filter tasks where completed is true

request.description: Demonstrates stretch goal filter: returns only completed tasks. (Status: 200 OK)

item.name: 3. GET Tasks Filter - Invalid completed Query Value (400 Bad Request)

request.description: Demonstrates Assignment Requirement 3: completed query param must only be 'true' or 'false'. Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.
Demonstrates Assignment Requirement 5: Valid task creation with future dueDate. (Status: 201 Created)

item.name: 5. POST Create Task - Invalid DueDate in Past (400 Bad Request)

request.description: Demonstrates Assignment Requirement 1 & 5: Rejects past dates if dueDate is earlier than today. (Status: 400 Bad Request)

item.name: 6. POST Create Task - Invalid Missing Title (400 Bad Request)

request.description: Rejects request when title is missing or empty. (Status: 400 Bad Request)

item.name: 7. GET Single Task - Valid ID (200 OK)

request.description: Retrieves a single task by its valid 24-character hexadecimal MongoDB ObjectId. (Status: 200 OK)

item.name: 8. GET Single Task - Invalid ID Format (400 Bad Request)

request.description: Demonstrates Assignment Requirement 2 & 5: param('id').isMongoId() catches invalid ID format on GET /tasks/:id before querying database. (Status: 400 Bad Request)

item.name: 9. GET Single Task - Non-Existent Valid ID (404 Not Found)

request.description: Demonstrates 404 Not Found when a valid 24-char ObjectId is provided but does not exist in the database. (Status: 404 Not Found)
Updates a task with valid fields and future dueDate. (Status: 200 OK)

item.name: 11. PUT Update Task - Invalid ID Format (400 Bad Request)

request.description: Demonstrates Assignment Requirement 2 & 5: param('id').isMongoId() catches invalid ID format on PUT /tasks/:id. (Status: 400 Bad Request)

item.name: 12. PUT Update Task - Invalid Past DueDate (400 Bad Request)

request.description: Demonstrates Assignment Requirement 1: Rejects updating dueDate to a past date. (Status: 400 Bad Request)

item.name: 13. DELETE Task - Invalid ID Format (400 Bad Request)

request.description: Demonstrates Assignment Requirement 2 & 5: param('id').isMongoId() catches invalid ID format on DELETE /tasks/:id. (Status: 400 Bad Request)
Deletes a task by valid MongoDB ID. (Status: 200 OK)
